title: Apply-time answer families bind the five elicits to the notifications-in-app contract
description: When the applying project answers the five apply-time elicits, the shell honours each with a runtime clause per family: `blueprint.json.elicits[id=timeout]` sets the toast timeout floor on ADR-2102 (a value below 6 seconds refuses at apply with TOAST_TIMEOUT_TOO_SHORT); `blueprint.json.elicits[id=retention]` sets the notification-centre retention window in days per ADR-2103; `blueprint.json.elicits[id=categories]` populates the per-category preference sections on TAC-2103; `blueprint.json.elicits[id=route]` sets the preferences route the shell mounts; `blueprint.json.elicits[id=page-size]` sets the notification-centre page size.
rationale: The five apply-time answer families named in the guide needed one must REQ per family so a project cannot elicit a value and see it ignored silently.
